# #channel-b — 2026-01-15

**ali** · 08:50
> postmortem: relay-service outage 2026-01-15, 08:02–08:16

**ali** · 08:52
> root cause: the upstream TLS certificate expired at 00:00. the connection pool surfaces a failed handshake as ERR-0451, which is why every request errored while the service itself was healthy.

**ali** · 08:54
> contributing factor: certificate renewal is a manual step that lives in one person's head. last week's outage (2026-01-08) was almost certainly the same failure mode — we restarted before capturing evidence, so we never saw it.

**ali** · 08:56
> action items: (1) automate cert renewal, (2) alert 14 days before expiry, (3) make ERR-0451 message include the handshake failure reason so it stops masquerading as a generic pool error

**dana** · 09:03
> good writeup. assigning the renewal automation to myself for this sprint

**ali** · 09:05
> thanks. also worth noting: the core dump from worker-3 was what cracked it — TimeoutError in worker-3 pointed straight at the handshake. arguing for those five minutes was the right call.

**dana** · 09:07
> noted for the runbook: capture first, restart second

**小北** · 09:12
> 小艾的复盘写得很清楚，证书的事我来盯后续

**dana** · 09:15
> adding a monthly cert-expiry review to the ops calendar

**ali** · 09:20
> closing this one out. next incident let's aim for boring.
